blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI was established based on the recommendations of the Malhotra Committee.
The Malhotra Committee submitted its key findings and recommendations in 1993.
The primary purpose of creating IRDAI was to allow private company participation and enhance competition in the insurance sector.
The Malhotra Committee (1993) is frequently asked as the foundational committee behind insurance reforms in India.
Exams often test the core objective of the Malhotra Committee: opening the insurance market to private players to boost competition.
